text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Hemolytic Disease (likely due to Rh or ABO incompatibility) causing severe unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia. The combination of extremely high indirect bilirubin (17.5 mg/dL), lack of direct bilirubin elevation, and the urgent need to rule out hemolysis suggests an immune-mediated destruction of red blood cells.
